title: Charles de Poupet, sieur de La Chaulx, to Charles V, Vitoria, 28 May 1522 (DECODE R1187)

steps.what: Fetched the 11 DECODE images with the stored cookie.
Web and archive.org search for a printed edition (Gachard 1859 Charles-Quint/Adrien VI).
Identified images 9-11 as a contemporary decipherment keyed A-E to the five marked cipher passages; letter is French, dated Vitoria 28 May 1522, not Spanish 1 Jan.
Aligned the first line of passage A with the decipherment: sign counts fit combien/que/je, e homophonic.
Transcribed decipherment sections A and b.

outcome.method_basis: The contemporary decipherment bound with the letter as BNE MSS/20212/39/2 gives all five cipher passages; it was aligned against the first cipher line of passage A but the key was not rebuilt.
outcome.notes: Read at the time; key not rebuilt.

prior.where: The 1522 decipherment bound with the letter, MSS/20212/39/2.
